subject: Budget sensitivity and $/1M token target — follow-up
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@medflow.ai>, Carlos Rivera <carlos@medflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Budget sensitivity and $/1M token target — follow-up

Samantha / Carlos — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can put together a clean cost comparison for your procurement team.

Recap from our call:
- Expected usage profile you mentioned: ~5M tokens/mo initial (pilot), ramp to ~30M within 6 months and a potential 75M+ /mo long-term if the integration goes well.
- Primary workloads: structured clinical note summarization and patient triage prompts (high avg token/turn).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II + self-hosting path are both relevant for you.

What we need to finalize a short model for legal/procurement: (please confirm by EOD Tue)
1) Confirm target budget range for inference (monthly): you mentioned a ballpark during the call — can you confirm a numeric range?
2) Confirm whether committed monthly minimums are acceptable for a discounted reserved rate vs a pay-as-you-go pilot.
3) Any blocking procurement constraints / procurement SLA targets (PO timing / invoicing terms)?

Preliminary commercial context (so you know where we're thinking):
- Quick host comparison (high-level): OpenAI / Anthropic hosted rates for heavy generation workloads typically land above $15–30 per 1M tokens depending on model and context length.
- Our standard hosted pilot posture: accelerated onboarding and predictable starter pricing; for customers in your profile we typically propose a two-phase cadence: short-term hosted pilot (no commit) + optional reserved capacity (12mo commit) if the pilot meets throughput/latency targets.

To make the ask concrete: can you share the token forecast workbook you mentioned (per-channel monthly forecast)? attaching a simple template would help — I can translate into a three-scenario $/1M comparison (pilot / dedicated / open-host equivalents) and show the tipping point where dedicated/reserved makes sense.

Next steps I propose:
- You send the forecast file (even a high-level sheet is fine).
- We return a 1-page cost comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and a clear pilot term sheet by Wed EOD.
- If that looks good, propose a procurement-friendly pilot: 25M tokens at a fixed $/1M for 60 days with optional rollover credits.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing_grid_v2.csv (preview of our model inputs)]

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129

From: Samantha Liu <samantha@medflow.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos@medflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget sensitivity and $/1M token target — follow-up

Thanks Vivek — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Revised forecast (high level): pilot = 5M tokens/mo (May–Jun), scale = 30M tokens/mo by Nov, stretch = 75M+/mo by next FY if model accuracy and latency hold. I attached the workbook we referenced in the call (MedFlow_Token_Forecast_Q2Q3.xlsx).
- Budget: procurement has given a target band of $12–$18 per 1M tokens for hosted APIs for now; they'd consider committed pricing if it brings us to low teens or high single-digits per 1M.
- Procurement timeline: target to finalize pilot commercial terms within 45–60 days. They will require standard PO / 30-day invoice terms.
- Security: SOC 2 report is required; air-gapped on-prem is a longer discussion but interesting later.

Can you include in the comparison a simple run-rate column showing (a) pay-as-you-go hosted at list, (b) pilot fixed-rate (no commit), and (c) 12mo reserved committed price. Also: please include an explicit column comparing the hypothetical $/1M against OpenAI and Anthropic baseline numbers — we need that for procurement.

Thanks, attaching the forecast file.

Attachments: [Attachment: MedFlow_Token_Forecast_Q2Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of Product
MedFlow AI
samantha@medflow.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Budget sensitivity and $/1M token target — follow-up

Ben / Laura — forwarding Sam's forecast and high-level asks. Key commercials they signaled: pilot 5M/mo -> 30M in six months; procurement target $12–$18 / 1M; 45–60 day timeline; SOC2 required.

Recommended go-to:
- Offer A (Hosted pilot, no commit): 25M token pilot at $15 / 1M (flat) for 60 days, with rollover up to 3 months. This maps to their upper budget band but keeps flexibility.
- Offer B (Reserved / Dedicated): 12mo commitment, target blended $8.00–$10.00 / 1M depending on commit bands (50–75M/mo class). Requires legal to draft an SLA + credits for under-performance.
- Quick rebuttal table vs open-hosts: show direct list pricing equivalents for OpenAI & Anthropic (we'll use public list numbers and a conservative host-performance uplift).

Ask Laura to prepare a one-page term summary + visible callouts on procurement / invoicing cadence. Ben — can you prep the two-line LOI (pilot commercial terms) we can send to Sam after I add the run-rate table?

I'm attaching the pricing grid I used to model the three scenarios. Will link the comparison doc once I drop it into Drive.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing_grid_v2.csv (internal pricing model)]

— Vivek

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@medflow.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget sensitivity and $/1M token target — follow-up

Samantha — thanks for the workbook, that helps a lot. I've attached a short two-page cost comparison (Redwood_vs_Others_1M_comparison.pdf) that lays out:
- Row: use-case scenarios (pilot / scale / stretch)
- Column: list-rate equivalent for OpenAI, Anthropic, Redwood hosted pilot, Redwood reserved (12mo)
- Column: monthly run-rate costs for the forecast you gave

Headline bullets from the attachment:
- If your ramp hits ~30M/mo within 6 months, the committed reserved path materially beats pay-as-you-go hosting; tipping point around 20–25M/mo for your workload.
- We can run a 60-day hosted pilot at $15 / 1M for 25M tokens, or propose reserved pricing that targets ~$9 / 1M at reach commit levels (requires 12mo).
- OpenAI / Anthropic public list numbers are included for procurement context; your $12–$18 target is reasonable for the pilot phase.

Next steps:
1) Quick call Wed 11:30am PT to walk the one-pager and agree pilot terms (I’ll send calendar invite).
2) If agreed, we’ll send the pilot LOI and SOC 2 report (redacted) to procurement.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_vs_Others_1M_comparison.pdf (pdf)]

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
